body.name: \widehat m^{\mathrm{tail}}_{a,\tau}
body.def: \(\widehat m^{\mathrm{tail}}_{a,\tau}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbf1\{A_i=a,\widehat\pi_{a,-k(i)}(X_i)\le\widehat p_{a,(k_n)}\}\widetilde\psi_{a,\tau,-k(i)}(Y_i)}{\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbf1\{A_i=a,\widehat\pi_{a,-k(i)}(X_i)\le\widehat p_{a,(k_n)}\}}\), with value zero when the denominator is zero
